reviews.raw:
{
  "verdict": "APPROVED",
  "summary": "Implementation matches PLAN-B74 across backend optimizations, regime fixes, and frontend features. Watchlist summary local price caching, MI_INDEX stock-column filtering, net breadth normalization, and Telegram premarket integration are well-implemented. One medium frontend timezone issue was found in forecast cone date calculations.",
  "findings": [
    {
      "id": "F1",
      "severity": "medium",
      "path": "regime-frontend/wave.js",
      "issue": "futureDays() produces off-by-one dates and weekend dates (Sundays) in Taiwan timezone (UTC+8)",
      "evidence": "In futureDays(last, n), 'new Date(last + \"T00:00:00\")' initializes a Date at local midnight (e.g. UTC+8). 'd.setDate(d.getDate() + 1)' moves to local Oct 21 00:00:00, but 'd.toISOString().slice(0, 10)' converts to UTC (Oct 20 16:00:00Z -> '2026-10-20'). As a result, out[0] duplicates 'last', trading days shift back 1 calendar day, and trading Mondays become Sundays ('2026-10-25') in the forecast cone series.",
      "suggestion": "Parse and iterate purely in UTC: 'const [y, m, day] = last.split(\"-\").map(Number); const d = new Date(Date.UTC(y, m - 1, day)); while (out.length < n) { d.setUTCDate(d.getUTCDate() + 1); if (d.getUTCDay() !== 0 && d.getUTCDay() !== 6) out.push(d.toISOString().slice(0, 10)); }'"
    },
    {
      "id": "F2",
      "severity": "low",
      "path": "regime-frontend/wave.js",
      "issue": "drawChart() may throw TypeError accessing bars[bars.length - 1].time if bars is empty",
      "evidence": "In line 265: 'if (!weekly && fc.h5 && fc.h20) { const last = bars[bars.length - 1].time; ...}'. If S.chart.bars is empty, bars[bars.length - 1] is undefined and .time will raise an uncaught exception, aborting the rest of drawChart().",
      "suggestion": "Add a length check: 'if (!weekly && fc.h5 && fc.h20 && bars.length) { ... }'"
    }
  ],
  "coverage": "Inspected all diffs for server.py, yahoo_price.py, regime/db.py, regime/factor.py, regime/fetcher.py, regime/router.py, course_live.py, tests/test_global_brief.py, dashboard.html, regime-frontend/index.html, and regime-frontend/wave.js against PLAN-B74.",
  "limitations": "Wave backend modules (wave/engine.py, wave/data.py, wave/panel.py, wave/levels.py, wave/chips.py, wave/globalx.py, wave/forecast.py) were audited separately in Group 1 and were not re-reviewed here except via their interfaces."
}

parsed.summary: Implementation matches PLAN-B74 across backend optimizations, regime fixes, and frontend features. Watchlist summary local price caching, MI_INDEX stock-column filtering, net breadth normalization, and Telegram premarket integration are well-implemented. One medium frontend timezone issue was found in forecast cone date calculations.

findings.issue: futureDays() produces off-by-one dates and weekend dates (Sundays) in Taiwan timezone (UTC+8)
findings.evidence: In futureDays(last, n), 'new Date(last + "T00:00:00")' initializes a Date at local midnight (e.g. UTC+8). 'd.setDate(d.getDate() + 1)' moves to local Oct 21 00:00:00, but 'd.toISOString().slice(0, 10)' converts to UTC (Oct 20 16:00:00Z -> '2026-10-20'). As a result, out[0] duplicates 'last', trading days shift back 1 calendar day, and trading Mondays become Sundays ('2026-10-25') in the forecast cone series.
findings.suggestion: Parse and iterate purely in UTC: 'const [y, m, day] = last.split("-").map(Number); const d = new Date(Date.UTC(y, m - 1, day)); while (out.length < n) { d.setUTCDate(d.getUTCDate() + 1); if (d.getUTCDay() !== 0 && d.getUTCDay() !== 6) out.push(d.toISOString().slice(0, 10)); }'

findings.issue: drawChart() may throw TypeError accessing bars[bars.length - 1].time if bars is empty
findings.evidence: In line 265: 'if (!weekly && fc.h5 && fc.h20) { const last = bars[bars.length - 1].time; ...}'. If S.chart.bars is empty, bars[bars.length - 1] is undefined and .time will raise an uncaught exception, aborting the rest of drawChart().
findings.suggestion: Add a length check: 'if (!weekly && fc.h5 && fc.h20 && bars.length) { ... }'
